question: Build me a renewal strategy for Helvetia Logistics AG.
expected_answer: Must include: (1) blocker: DACH notice is 120 days, so the notice date was Oct 3, 2026 and has passed, so an uplift needs the customer's written agreement; (2) blocker: DPA v3.1 must be re-signed on v4.2 before booking; (3) health 64 (Amber), driven by exec sponsor change and 1 open P1; (4) consumption: E overage ~117% → true-up (expansion ACV), F shelfware ~23% → adoption plan, A ~64% and declining, B ~93% expansion-ready; (5) Renew Early (105% quota) if closed by Dec 2, 2026; Cross-Sell Champion 200% for a new product; no Product F promo or AI SPIFF in EMEA; (6) scenarios with ACV and quota impact.
source_doc_ids: EMEA-REN-201; GLB-REN-001; GLB-ACV-002; GLB-HEALTH-007; EMEA-PROG-203; EMEA-PROMO-202; EMEA-BENCH-204

question: Andes Retail Group is renewing soon. What's the risk and what should I do?
expected_answer: Health 36 (Red): exec sponsor changed, 2 open P1 cases, Product A declining (~65%), Product H shelfware (~23%). Register with Save Desk (health <50). LATAM notice is 60 days → Nov 16, 2026 (not yet passed). Logo Retention SPIFF $1,000 if it renews flat or higher. Commerce Fiesta (30% off Product H fee, Oct 1–Dec 31, 2026) and AI Agents Pilot (ACV ≥ $100k, owns A) are eligible. No Renew Early in LATAM.

question: What uplift can I put on Harbor City Transit Authority's renewal, and when must I send notice?
expected_answer: US Public Sector: uplift capped at 3%; notice is 120 days → Dec 1, 2026 (contract ends Mar 31, 2027).

question: Can I book Saffron Retail's renewal today if they sign?
expected_answer: Not until the customer's GSTIN is on the order form (none on file). India also adds 18% GST. Notice period is 60 days.

question: Summit Ridge Software is over its Product E commitment. If I true it up at renewal, how much ACV, commission, quota and SPIFF is that?
expected_answer: Trailing 3-month run rate × 12 ≈ 4,086,908 credits vs. 3,500,000 committed → true-up ≈ 586,908 credits × $0.051 ≈ $29,932 expansion ACV. Commission 7% ≈ $2,095; quota retired 100% ≈ $29,932; plus AMER Consumption True-Up SPIFF $1,000. (AE-101 is at 112% attainment, so the 1.5x accelerator applies: commission ≈ $3,143.)

question: Prairie Fresh Grocers barely uses Product G. Can I cut it at renewal?
expected_answer: Yes, it qualifies: utilization below 50% for 3+ months (last 3 months 22%, 22%, 21%). AE can approve up to a 20% quantity reduction (more needs RVP). Offer an adoption plan first. Lost ACV is attrition, deducted 100% from the renewal's quota credit. Cutting G by 20% ≈ $8,280 (2.9% of account ACV), under AMER's 15% Deal Desk threshold.

question: How much quota will I retire if Canberra Digital Services Agency renews flat?
expected_answer: ANZ Quota Booster: Strategic renewals retire 120% of renewal ACV → 1.2 × $3,686,400 = $4,423,680. Also: government customer must be on in-country data residency.

question: What promotions can I offer Thames Valley Building Society?
expected_answer: Service Switch: 25% off year 1 of Product B, because they're Financial Services and don't own B (valid until Nov 30, 2026). Portal for Public Services doesn't apply (not Public Sector/Healthcare). No Product F promo in EMEA. Adding B also earns Cross-Sell Champion (200% quota).

question: Jordan Ellis is at 112% of quota. How is commission paid on his next renewals?
expected_answer: Attainment between 100% and 125%: incremental bookings are paid at 1.5x the standard rate.

question: If Lakeshore Mutual Insurance signs a flat 3-year renewal, what does the Multi-Year Kicker pay?

question: What can I offer Kiwi Harbour Bank to grow the renewal?
expected_answer: AI Agents Accelerate ANZ: 25% off year 1 of Product F (Enterprise, owns A and B), valid Sep 1–Dec 31, 2026, not stackable. AI Attach SPIFF A$2,000 if the commitment is ≥500,000 credits. Gov Ready Service doesn't apply.

question: Does overage on a consumption product count as ACV?
expected_answer: No. Overage is billed in arrears at list price and isn't ACV. It becomes expansion ACV only when converted into a committed true-up at renewal.

question: Why is Helvetia Logistics AG's health score amber?
expected_answer: Score 64: exec sponsor changed (15% weight scored 30), 1 open P1 (support 60), and mixed utilization: Product F shelfware and Product A declining offset by B and E. Formula: 40% utilization + 20% trend + 15% support + 15% exec sponsor + 10% breadth.

question: São Paulo Saúde renews on Oct 31, 2026. Can I still add an uplift?
expected_answer: Not unilaterally. LATAM notice is 60 days, so the notice date was Sep 1, 2026 and has passed; an uplift needs written agreement. Auto-renew is ON, so it renews at the current price if nothing is signed. Unsigned at T-30 → escalate to RVP and Deal Desk. LATAM has no Renew Early program. Brazil invoices need a Nota Fiscal.
